$schema: Kenney "RPG Audio" + "Music Jingles" (both CC0), hand-picked and re-encoded for this app. See LICENSE.txt and docs/decisions.md D-047.
format: PCM s16le, 44.1kHz, mono, peak-normalised to -1.0 dBFS — decodeAudioData-safe on Safari/iOS
status: In use. src/lib/domain/sound-cues.ts maps every app action to a file here or in ../ui/; src/lib/sound.ts plays it.
note: These are the cues that needed a musical or physical character the Interface Sounds pack does not contain (page turns, treasure, jingles). Plain UI feedback still comes from ../ui/.

files.hint: a soft cover opening — the page beneath the clasp
a metal clasp springing open — the grimoire being unlocked
ascending pizzicato, full run — RARE 7-8 quest clear
ascending pizzicato, 2 steps — RARE 1-3 quest clear
ascending pizzicato, 3 steps — RARE 4-6 quest clear
ascending steel bells, the longest cue here — every quest cleared
ascending steel bells rising an octave — the app-open flourish
a slow low steel bell, no melodic rise — the morning greeting
a medium page flip — arriving at the survey-record calendar
a quick light page flip — arriving at the daily quest page
a heavy door swinging open — arriving at the research lab
a slow heavy parchment flip — arriving at the collection
a short coin tick — looking back at something already earned
a handful of coins being turned over — a bounty paid out
